Product Details: The HomePlus Pro is a solar home system that is designed to provide comprehensive lighting and phone charging for families and businesses without access to electricity. The large battery and solar panel provide reliable phone charging and lighting. A battery management system automatically dims the lamps and pauses phone charging when the battery charge is low, providing extended lighting for several hours until sunrise. What's in the box; 1 x solar panel , 4x 240 Lumens Tube Lights, 1 x USB-A phone charging port, 38.4 Wh LFP Battery
